cand.title: GVA Workshop 2027
cand.excerpt: Strong event evidence and date/venue specificity; ranking reflects venue commitment and YOTEL distance/access constraints.

quote.assumption: exa agent fixed effort=high (contact enrichment not included)

findings.namedBuyers: Two commercially relevant organizer-side contacts are verified: Nicolas Simonin, Responsable développement Tourisme/Transport, named as an organizer and the direct exhibitor-registration recipient; and Yves-Daniel Viredaz, Head of Business Development, named co-organizer and senior commercial relationship lead. Both appear in 2026 event reporting. Neither is established as a hotel-contract signatory or housing buyer.
findings.futureEdition: The next announced edition is the fifth GVA Workshop on 27 May 2027, a one-day event at restaurant Le Chef, Genève Aéroport, Geneva, Canton of Geneva, Switzerland. Actual activity date, not publication date: the media-partner announcement was published 12 October 2026 and states “le 27 mai 2027 au restaurant Le Chef de l’aéroport de Genève”. The Swiss Travel Association calendar independently lists the same date and venue, attributed to Genève Aéroport. The airport event page retrieved still describes 4 June 2026; no airport-owned 2027 prospectus was located. No 2028 date was located. Calendar corroboration comes from its indexed event listing; the fetched calendar text did not reproduce that 2027 entry.
findings.hotelProductFit: Inference using the supplied hotel specifications: YOTEL Geneva Lake is potentially suitable for a separately requested small airline/organizer overnight group, training session or ancillary meeting, not for replacing the already announced airport venue. Its Founex location is outside the terminal and requires a workable transfer arrangement. Historical audience scale is within the supplied approximately 250-theatre meeting limit, but the multi-table workshop layout and cocktail catering would need separate validation; catering scale remains unverified. Attendance is not room demand. Do not propose a 20–120-room block without buyer evidence, and do not imply demand for all 237 rooms. This is an airport-based professional networking event, not a resort retreat.
findings.venueCommitments: Publicly announced 2027 venue: restaurant Le Chef at Genève Aéroport, Route de l’aéroport 13, third floor, CH-1215 Genève, Switzerland. Territory: Geneva Airport corridor, not Founex/Nyon/La Côte and not a downtown-Geneva meeting venue. This is a restaurant, not a competing hotel. The venue announcement establishes a planned commitment, not inspection of a signed contract.
findings.historicalRotation: No destination or venue rotation was found: editions in 2023, 2024, 2025 and 2026 used Le Chef at Geneva Airport, and 2027 is announced there again. Dates: 22 June 2023; 6 June 2024; 22 May 2025; 4 June 2026. An early June 2025 article provisionally announced 28 May 2026, superseded by the airport’s 4 June 2026 programme and subsequent coverage. Do not use that superseded date. Annual recurrence is explicit in the airport’s description, not merely inferred from consecutive years.
findings.accommodationSourcing: Unknown. No edition-specific housing bureau, host hotel, hotel room block, hotel booking commitment, accommodation RFP, peak-room count or room-night count was found. No hotels are listed as accommodation providers in the reviewed event materials. The published 2026 sourcing pathway is exhibitor registration direct to the airport: “return it by email (nicolas.simonin@gva.ch)”; this is not a hotel-procurement invitation. The 2026 exhibitor package states “Participation forfaitaire de CHF 900.- HT comprenant” and lists a table, chairs, airline representatives, limited parking and Wi-Fi, without lodging. Neither this omission nor a restaurant venue proves accommodation is open or unnecessary.
findings.organizationStructure: The owner/organizer is Genève Aéroport, operating through its marketing/business-development team, not an association conference organizer. Its official legal description is “un établissement public autonome”, owned by the State of Geneva. TRAVEL INSIDE is explicitly the media partner; Le Chef is the venue. No appointed PCO, DMC, agency or housing bureau was identified. The Swiss Travel Association is a calendar publisher here, not the identified event owner.
findings.competitiveLimitations: Le Chef is the incumbent meeting venue, not an incumbent hotel. Repeated use since launch, airline-focused exhibitor eligibility and the airport-hosted format limit primary-venue capture. Historical exhibitor conditions covered one airline per table, or two alliance airlines sharing: a hotel cannot assume eligibility to buy a normal airline stand. No hotel overflow, hotel sell-out, competing contracted accommodation or unmet lodging demand was found. Conference panel participation by hospitality professionals is not evidence of a hotel room block.
findings.recommendedSalesAction: Approach Nicolas Simonin first through the published nicolas.simonin@gva.ch and request confirmation of the 2027 programme, whether any airline representatives or organizers require overnight rooms, and who chooses/pays for those rooms. Ask whether hotel participation or an ancillary hotel visit is permitted rather than assuming airline-stand eligibility. Include Yves-Daniel Viredaz for the wider airport/airline relationship. Offer a site visit or a tightly scoped ancillary-stay/meeting proposal only after need and transfers are confirmed. Do not send a primary-event-venue bid against Le Chef or classify this as an active room-block opportunity.
findings.currentEditionAccessibility: For 27 May 2027, the meeting venue is already announced elsewhere; accommodation remains unconfirmed, not confirmed open or confirmed committed to another hotel. A direct hotel sales path is conditional on organizer confirmation of out-of-area overnight attendees and independently sourced lodging. The published audience is travel agencies, tour operators and travel managers from French-speaking Switzerland and neighboring France; this does not prove they fly in or stay overnight. Event is at Geneva Airport, not Lausanne or French Pays de Gex; no delegate lodging toward La Côte was established. No 2027 registration terms were located.
findings.futureCompetitiveCapturePotential: Inference: prioritize a recurring airport/travel-trade relationship over displacement of the flagship workshop. The airport explicitly describes an annual event, but no 2028 date, venue competition, relocation plan or hotel RFP was found. Possible later business is separately commissioned airline meetings, training or organizer/exhibitor stays only if a buyer establishes demand. Future venue capture is speculative given the uninterrupted airport-restaurant history.
